exams.name: CPA Examination
exams.notes: Board prescribes methods of applying, completing, and grading; may use an examination from any provider approved by the Board. Conditional credit available for passing individual sections.
exams.quote: The Board shall prescribe by regulation the: (a) Methods of applying for an examination; (b) Methods of completing an examination, including grading and the requirements to pass the examination; and (c) Education required to be eligible to take an examination. (2) The Board may use an examination from any provider as approved by the Board.

interval_years.quote: All permits expire on December 31 of each year and may be renewed annually for a period of 1 year by holders of certificates in good standing upon payment of an annual renewal fee set by the Board by regulation.

required.quote: the holder of a certificate has complied with the continuing education requirements provided in this chapter and in the Board's regulations

available.quote: The Board may waive the examination, the requirements for education or the requirements for work experience, or any combination thereof, required under NRS 628.190, and may issue a certificate as a certified public accountant to any person who is the holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant then in effect issued under the laws of any state or other jurisdiction of the United States approved by the Board

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed a substantially equivalent examination with a passing grade, have experience in public accountancy for more than 4 of the 10 preceding years, and the education requirements of the other state must satisfy Nevada's requirements. Has received a certificate as a certified public accountant under NRS 628.190 to 628.310, inclusive, holds a live permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant or permit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant or in obtaining a permit to practice public accounting under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence by a CPA or person/firm granted practice privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of NRS Chapter 628
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a regulation or rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a regulation or rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board under the authority granted by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of public accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of public accounting under the laws of any state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty, fraud, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime: (1) An element of which is dishonesty or fraud; or (2) Involving moral turpitude, under the laws of any state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, probation, or refusal to renew authority in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, placing on probation or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant by any other state, for any cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation or probation of right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension, revocation or placing on probation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain an annual permit within 60 days of expiration (when not on inactive/retired status)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unless the person has been placed on inactive or retired status, failure to obtain an annual permit under NRS 628.380, within: (1) Sixty days after the expiration date of the permit to practice last obtained or renewed by the holder of a certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct discreditable to the profession or reflecting adversely on fitness to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct discreditable to the profession of public accounting or which reflects adversely upon the fitness of the person to engage in the practice of public accounting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading statement in support of an application for a certificate or permit of another person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement in support of an application for a certificate or permit of another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act in another state or jurisdiction which would be subject to discipline there
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act in another state or jurisdiction which would be subject to discipline in that state.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each office established or maintained in this State for the practice of public accounting in this State by a certified public accountant or a partnership, corporation or limited-liability company composed of certified public accountants must be registered annually under this chapter with the Board.

definition_quote.value: the offering to perform or the performance by a holder of a live permit or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315, for a client or potential client, of one or more services involving the use of skills in accounting or auditing, one or more services relating to advising or consulting with clients on matters relating to management or the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on matters relating to taxes.

practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: A natural person granted practice privileges pursuant to subsection 1 and a partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship that employs such a natural person or a certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to subsection 1 shall be deemed to consent, as a condition of the grant of such practice privileges: (a) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction, and disciplinary authority, of the Board. (b) To comply with the provisions of this chapter and the regulations of the Board.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of a corporation, partnership or limited-liability company organized for the practice of public accounting in this State, in terms of the financial interests and voting rights of all shareholders, partners, officers, members and principals thereof, must belong to persons who are certified public accountants in any state.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A corporation, partnership or limited-liability company organized for the practice of public accounting in this State may have as a shareholder, partner, officer, member or principal any natural person who is not a certified public accountant in any state if: (a) The natural person is actively engaged in the business of the corporation, partnership or limited-liability company, or any affiliate thereof

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The Board may provide by regulation for the placing of certificates on a retired or inactive status.

retired_license_status_available.quote: The Board may provide by regulation for the placing of certificates on a retired or inactive status.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each manager in charge of an office of the partnership in this State must be a certified public accountant of this State in good standing.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: A person who, on his or her own behalf or on behalf of a partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship, signs or authorizes another to sign an accountant's report on financial statements shall meet the requirements for competency as set forth in the professional standards of accounting.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315 incident to or in the course of professional service to clients by the accountant, except reports submitted by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315 to a client, are the property of the accountant, in the absence of an express agreement between the accountant and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Any person who does not hold a live permit from preparing a financial statement or issuing a report if the statement or report, respectively, includes a disclosure that: (1) The person who prepared the statement or issued the report does not hold a live permit issued by the Board; and (2) The statement or report does not purport to have been prepared in compliance with the professional standards of accounting adopted by the Board.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The Board may issue a certificate as a certified public accountant to any person who is the holder of an equivalent certificate then in effect issued by a foreign country if: (a) Persons who are certified as public accountants in this State are granted similar privileges by the foreign country in which the applicant is certified

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: a partnership, corporation or limited-liability company with an office in this State shall register with the Board if the partnership, corporation or limited-liability company: (a) Performs attest services; (b) Performs compilation services; (c) Is engaged in the practice of public accounting
